note: Facts published after 30-Sep-2026. Not used in the initiation (as-of rule, PLAYBOOK §1); kept for the first update. Per-share figures in Screener are post-bonus (halve the report's pre-bonus figures to compare).

facts.fact: Board fixed 4-Nov-2026 as the record date for the 1:1 bonus (approved 23-Sep-2026).
10,46,16,204 bonus shares allotted on 4-Nov-2026 (1:1); shares outstanding 20,92,32,408. Screener restated EPS, prices and book value for the bonus.

Q2FY27 (Sep-2026 quarter, Screener consolidated): revenue Rs309 cr (+25% YoY), EBITDA Rs104 cr (34% margin), other income Rs10 cr, PAT Rs70 cr, EPS Rs3.38 post-bonus (Rs6.76 pre-bonus). Call held 28-Oct-2026.
Sep-2026 balance sheet (Screener): investments Rs533 cr, CWIP Rs112 cr, borrowings Rs2 cr, net worth Rs2,075 cr.
Sep-2026 shareholding: promoters 44.09%, FIIs 7.28%, DIIs 10.95%, public 37.68%, 88,365 shareholders; Nov-2026: DIIs 11.02%.

Share price Rs548.9 post-bonus (Rs1,097.8 pre-bonus equivalent), -20% from the 30-Sep close; S&P Global consensus mean target Rs760.5 post-bonus (5 analysts; range Rs680-850), FY27E EPS Rs32.14 (basis unclear).
Concord to attend a UBS non-deal roadshow in Singapore on 3-4 Nov-2026.
